create_viewer_subclass: create a custom visualizer by subclassing Viewer and implementing render_callback for motion sequences
run_viewer: run the Viewer instance to display an interactive GLUT window with camera controls and keyboard input
render_callback_method: implement the render_callback method in a Viewer subclass to draw 3D OpenGL geometry each frame
keyboard_callback_method: implement the keyboard_callback method to handle custom key presses and return True to consume the event
save_screen_screenshot: call save_screen on a Viewer instance to capture and save the current viewport as a PNG image
